stories.title: Pakistan responds to unprovoked firing from Afghan posts along border in Lower South Waziristan: DC
stories.brief: Pakistani security forces have responded to unprovoked firing from the Afghan border posts, the deputy commissioner of Lower South Waziristan district said on Sunday.

stories.title: ‘We’re technology-savvy’: DG ISPR says Pakistan ahead of India, Afghan Taliban in operational readiness
stories.brief: Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) Director General Lieutenant General Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry has affirmed that Pakistan is “much ahead” in operational readiness compared to the Afghan Taliban and India, adding that the country’s military is adopting emerging technologies.

stories.title: Pakistan capable of intercepting any drones sent from Afghanistan, India: DG ISPR
stories.brief: He alleged that the Afghan Taliban were acting as India's proxy in the context of terrorism in Pakistan. Asked whether isolating the Taliban would help Afghanistan, particularly amid concerns about the impact of the opium ban and reduced foreign assistance to farmers, Lt Gen Chaudhry said Pakistan was not advocating the country's isolation.

stories.title: Security forces respond to unprovoked firing from Afghan border posts: DC South Waziristan
stories.brief: Security forces responded to unprovoked firing from Afghan border posts near Angoor Adda in South Waziristan, forcing Afghan Taliban personnel to abandon their positions, Lower South Waziristan deputy commissioner said on Sunday.

stories.title: Till I am here, people of KP will have the first right to its resources: Kundi
stories.brief: The governor, who has assumed the administrative control of KP following the imposition of governor’s rule and emergency in the province, assured that his priority was the protection of the people of KP, then of the province itself and then Pakistan.

stories.title: Kundi says K-P's people will have 'first right' to province’s natural resources
stories.brief: Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P) Governor Faisal Karim Kundi on Sunday said the province's people would have the "first right" to its natural resources, pledging that their interests would remain his priority while he held office.

stories.title: Polio case from KP's Khyber takes nationwide tally for 2026 to eight
stories.brief: The latest case was from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s Khyber district, where the affected child is a 13-month-old girl from Union Council Janbaz-B in the Bara tehsil, according to the Pakistan Polio Eradication Programme (PPEP).

stories.title: PIA's first Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner arrives in Islamabad
stories.brief: Pakistan International Airlines’ (PIA) first Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner, acquired on lease last month, arrived in Islamabad from London as flight PK786 on Sunday. A PIA spokesperson, in a statement, said that the carrier is the first Pakistani airline to have added a Boeing 787-9 to its fleet.

stories.title: Pakistan's polio tally reaches eight with new case in K-P
stories.brief: The National Emergency Operations Centre (NEOC) for Polio Eradication confirmed Pakistan’s seventh polio case of the year, reported from Khyber district of Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P).

stories.title: PIA welcomes its first Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner in Islamabad
stories.brief: Pakistan International Airlines’ (PIA) first Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner arrived in Islamabad from London on Sunday, marking a new development in the national carrier’s efforts to modernise its fleet and expand international operations.

stories.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
stories.brief: Five officers from the Hamas-run police have been killed in Khan Younis and three people, including a child, killed in Gaza City, officials say.

stories.title: Bute House protested by environmental campaigners
stories.brief: A Halloween-themed protest against fossil fuels has targeted the first minister's residence in Edinburgh.

stories.title: Crew from NASA's simulated Mars mission emerges after 378 days in isolation
stories.brief: This was NASA's second ​CHAPEA mission, with another four-person ⁠crew in isolation at Johnson Space Center for 378 days spanning 2023 and 2024. Vanessa Wyche, director of the Johnson Space Center, greeted the crew members when they exited isolation.

stories.title: US hears Pakistan’s concerns over terrorism from Afghanistan, would play ‘productive role’ if there is one: Rubio
stories.brief: Mentioning that the US did not “necessarily [have] the closest relationship” with the Afghan Taliban, Rubio added: “We’ve heard the concerns that Pakistan has raised and we’ve seen some of those attacks that they point to.

stories.title: Iran warns US of prolonged war after Trump signals more strikes
stories.brief: Iran warned on Sunday that any renewed war with the United States could last longer than the previous round of fighting, after President Donald Trump said he still had to “take care” of more targets.

stories.title: Qatar offers 30-day tourist visa on arrival to Pakistani travellers subject to conditions
stories.brief: Pakistani nationals travelling to Qatar can obtain a 30-day tourist visa on arrival, provided they meet a set of requirements, Doha News reported on Sunday, citing the country's Ministry of Interior (MoI).

stories.title: Pakistan embassy rejects reports of attack on ambassador in Tehran as ‘baseless’
stories.brief: The Embassy of Pakistan in Tehran categorically rejected reports circulating on social media and other forums concerning Ambassador Imran Ahmed Siddiqui, describing them as baseless and factually incorrect.

stories.title: Israeli strikes kill eight people in Gaza - medics say
stories.brief: Israeli strikes killed at least eight Palestinians, including five police officers, in the Gaza Strip in two separate attacks on ​Sunday, according to medics and the Hamas-run interior ministry. Israeli strikes killed eight people, including a child, in Gaza on Sunday, according to emergency services and local hospitals.

stories.title: Rubio says US open to role on Pakistan’s Afghan terror concerns
stories.brief: Islamabad has repeatedly urged the Afghan Taliban administration to prevent terrorist organisations, particularly the Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), from using its territory to launch attacks inside Pakistan.
